video_title: Cason Wallace On Guarding Kyrie Irving, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander & The OKC Thunder-Spurs Rivalry

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on the difficulty of guarding Kyrie Irving
quotes.excerpt: Kyrie, his bag is like, it's hard to watch film on him.
quotes.quote: Kyrie, his bag is like, it's hard to watch film on him. You watch film and every clip is different. And it's all buckets, so he's number two.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on the OKC Thunder's rivalry with the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: They beat us. They beat us in the season, they beat us in the playoffs.
quotes.quote: They beat us. We just keep it 100 like they beat us. They beat us in the season, they beat us in the playoffs. So it's like, we got to fight back. And for us to have the best record in the league, two, three years in a row, and then for them to come in and this past season and do what they did, it's like our competitive spirit is like, yo, we got to we got to beat them.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Tracy McGrady on the psychological warfare between OKC and San Antonio
quotes.excerpt: This season to me for you guys, actually for both teams, was a psychological warfare.
quotes.quote: This season to me for you guys, actually for both teams, was a psychological warfare. Because you guys have played so many games against each other before you even got to the playoffs. You played each other in the cup. And that regular season record, San Antonio was what, four and one? So going into the playoffs, and when you sense there's any doubt in your mind that you with this your opposing team, if you sense there's any chink in that armor, you know you got them.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on the Thunder's competitive response to San Antonio
quotes.excerpt: We're not worried about regular season. We know that happened and we didn't win the regular season battle.
quotes.quote: We're not worried about regular season. We know that happened and we didn't win the regular season battle. Okay, cool. We got to line up with them for a whole seven game series now. The best man is going to win. At the end of the day, the best team is going to win. And they were the best team.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on playing against his brother in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: Being able to share the court with him, our first time in the NBA, the highest level of basketball.
quotes.quote: That was our first time ever sharing the court with each other. We're five years apart, so I always missed him in high school, college, obviously. But being able to share the court with him, our first time in the NBA, the highest level of basketball, it was like, that was amazing. We got our family here.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Tracy McGrady on the media-created rivalry with Vince Carter
quotes.excerpt: The media created like this whole soap opera between the between the two.
quotes.quote: The media created like this whole soap opera between the between the two. And it got ugly. So when I came back, of course the fans are going to take up for their side. They booed the shit out of me because it was crazy. I ain't even run out on the court yet and it was loud. I said, but it's going to be a great night.
